== Biography ==

'''Rose Allan''' married [[Glasgow-4179|John Glasgow]] in 1769, according to a family chronology transcribing the Old Kilwaughter/Larne Non-Subscribing Presbyterian register in County Antrim.<ref name="Timeline">Donna Jean Glasgow, [https://web.archive.org/web/20101124184247id_/http://lifesweaving.com/Glasgow/Kilwaughter/Timeline.html "GLASGOWS from Kilwaughter Parish and Larne, County Antrim, Northern Ireland … Timeline"] (archived 24 November 2010), a transcription of the Old Kilwaughter/Larne Non-Subscribing Presbyterian register entries. The chronology records "John3 Glasgow m. Rose Allan in 1769".</ref>

Her birth is estimated about 1750 from a marriage in 1769; the place is inferred from that Larne marriage and is not independently recorded.

== Research Notes ==

No record of Rose's parents, birth or death has been identified in this research. About 1750 is only a rough estimate from the 1769 marriage, not a recorded birth year.

The chronology's estimate “born perhaps 1745–48” concerns her husband John, not Rose. It does not supply Rose's birthplace or identify her husband as [[Glasgow-2846|John Glasgow of West Calder]]. No source identified here supports a separate Rose Allan baptism at West Calder in 1748. The Scottish John has a separate parentage and baptism citation; the Larne marriage does not establish that he was this Rose's husband.<ref name="Timeline" />
